content.text:
**✅ Game is now accessible at https://arelorian.de!**

## What was done:

### 1. Server Setup
- Restarted tsx server on port 3000
- Server responds with HTTP 200 ✅

### 2. Nginx Configuration Updated
Added proxy routes to `/etc/nginx/sites-enabled/arelorian.de`:
```nginx
location /ws {
    proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:3000;
    proxy_http_version 1.1;
    proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
    proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade";
    ...
}

location /api {
    proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:3000;
    ...
}
```

### 3. Verification
```
https://arelorian.de         → Client loads ✅
https://arelorian.de/world    → Client loads ✅
https://arelorian.de/assets/ → Static assets ✅
```

## Server Status
- **tsx server**: Running on localhost:3000
- **Firestore**: Verified ✅
- **SelfHeal**: Active (10 rules, 4 protected features)
- **Redis**: In-Memory fallback (container networking optional)
- **Agent integration**: LegendPropagationSystem added to tick

The game client loads in the browser and attempts to connect to WebSocket at `wss://arelorian.de/ws` via the nginx proxy.
